subject: Scheduling: cross-region demo — early/late slot tradeoffs and DST note
messages:
From: Maria Jones <maria.jones@brightwell.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@brightwell.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Intro + demo for Redwood inference - timezone question

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Brightwell is evaluating inference platforms for a couple of pilots (patient triage routing + note embeddings). We’d love a short product walkthrough (30–40 min) focused on latency/cost tradeoffs and private deployment options.

Quick note on scheduling — our core team is US East (NYC) and one engineering lead is in Amsterdam. We also have a small APAC support node (Singapore) who would join if the slot is reasonable locally.

Do you have any availability next week? Rough preferences:
- Prefer not before 08:00 PT (too early for Bay area stakeholders)
- Prefer not after 18:00 CET (too late for EU folks)

If you can propose a couple of windows with clear PT/CET/SGT conversions that’d help. I attached a short doc with our goals.

Thanks —
Maria
Maria Jones
Head of Digital Ops, Brightwell Health
Attachments: Brightwell-demo-requirements.pdf (1 page)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Jones <maria.jones@brightwell.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 18:07:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo for Redwood inference - timezone question

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the brief and the attachment — helpful. Looping in Vivek (serving/runtime) and Grace (solutions). We can do a concise 35-minute walkthrough + 10 minutes for Q&A. A couple of practical notes up-front:
- We’re running a small EU presence, so presenters can be in CET.
- There’s an upcoming DST boundary this week (EU switches back a week earlier than the US), so wall-clock conversions for next-week meetings can be off by an hour if calendars were booked with different locales. I’ll include both CET and PT conversions explicitly.

Proposed windows (all dates: Weds Nov 2, duration 45 min) — listed as CET / PT / SGT:
1) 16:00 CET / 07:00 PT / 23:00 SGT (early for PT)
2) 17:00 CET / 08:00 PT / 00:00 SGT (borderline for SGT)
3) 14:00 CET / 05:00 PT / 22:00 SGT (too early for PT)

If none of those work, we can offer Tue Nov 1 15:00 CET / 06:00 PT (earlier) or Thu Nov 3 10:00 CET / 01:00 PT (late for US). My recommendation is option 2 — best balance: EU folks finish their day, US West can join at a normal morning time, and APAC can dial in late evening if needed.

Vivek — can you confirm if the EU engineer (our latency SME) is available for the 17:00 CET slot? Grace — I’ll draft a short agenda and send the calendar invite once we lock time.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Maria Jones <maria.jones@brightwell.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 18:54:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo for Redwood inference - timezone question

Irene —

17:00 CET on Nov 2 should work for the EU engineer (I checked with him). A few operational notes:
- If Brightwell wants a short live test of a sample prompt, we’ll need 10 extra minutes for tokenization/kicking a small model run; recommend adding +10 to the 35 planned.
- If APAC attends, we should confirm whether they need the full walkthrough or just the recording + Q&A; running live across three regions increases the chance of join/no-join.

Avail check matrix (Nov 2):
- Vivek (EU engineer): 16:00–18:30 CET — available
- Irene: 15:30–17:30 CET — available if we start at 17:00
- Grace: 17:00–18:15 CET — available

I support option 2 as the least disruptive. If Maria confirms APAC can take the recording, we lock 17:00 CET and send invite.

—Vivek
From: Maria Jones <maria.jones@brightwell.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@brightwell.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 08:21:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo for Redwood inference - timezone question

Thanks — helpful options and appreciate the DST call-out. Two quick asks before we lock:
1) Could we push to 17:00 CET rather than 16:00 CET (your option 2 already lists 17:00 CET as the preferred) — 17:00 CET is ideal for our Amsterdam lead (not earlier).
2) Our Singapore support can’t do full live at midnight; they’d prefer the recording and to drop into the last 10 minutes if possible.

If 17:00 CET / 08:00 PT on Nov 2 works for you and your EU engineer, please send the calendar invite and an agenda. Also, can you include a short note on expected attendee roles from Redwood (presenter, latency SME, solutions)? That helps our scheduling.

I’ve attached a one-pager with our compliance questions that Grace may want to review ahead of the call.

—Maria
Attachments: Brightwell-demo-requirements.pdf (same), Brightwell-compliance-questions.xlsx (1 sheet)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:41:00 +01:00

Perfect — locking 17:00 CET / 08:00 PT on Tue, 2 Nov 2026. Calendar invite + agenda attached and sent separately (Calendar-invite.ics; Redwood-proposed-agenda.docx).

Quick agenda (sent as attachment and pasted here):
- 0:00–0:05 Intro + goals (Irene)
- 0:05–0:20 Platform tour: hosting modes + routing policies (Grace)
- 0:20–0:35 Latency demo + tokenized example run (Vivek) — needs +10 min contingency if we run live test
- 0:35–0:40 Q&A / next steps (All)

Attendees from Redwood: Irene (presenter/solutions), Grace (product/console walkthrough), Vivek (latency/runtime SME). We’ll record and share the recording for your APAC lead; we’ll keep the last 10 minutes as the Q&A window they can join into.

If Brightwell wants a short pre-call on compliance (SOC2, data handling), Grace is happy to take a 20-min slot earlier that day — propose 14:30 CET if you’d like that.

Thanks — sending the invite now. Looking forward to it.

—Irene
